# Book My Game — Kurnool

> Hyperlocal sports venue & hourly slot reservation web platform for Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh.

## Platform Summary
- **Target Area**: Kurnool city (Budhawarpet, Joharapuram, B-Camp, Nandyal Road, Venkataramana Colony, Alur Road).
- **Sports Covered**: Cricket box nets, football turf, badminton indoor courts, swimming pools, basketball, tennis courts.
- **Payment Method**: Direct on-venue UPI / cash payments + 9% transparent convenience fee auto-locked on booking.
- **Verified Turf Registration**: Real owners provide turf photo proof, legal ownership verification, operating hours, and UPI receiver ID.
- **Architecture**: Express REST API backend + Vite React TypeScript responsive web app.

## Key Web Pages
- `/` - Home pitch: sport categories, search bar, trending Kurnool venues
- `/#venues` - Complete sports ground catalog with area and price filters
- `/#bookings` - Player match passes with verification QR code
- `/#owner` - Turf owner management console & legal facility onboarding

## Security & Privacy
- Zero mobile APK distribution — 100% web-first PWA.
- Password hashing with bcrypt, JWT token authentication, rate limiting, and OWASP Top 10 security headers.
- Real owner verification checks to eliminate fake listings.
